SessionAuth.name: SESSION
SessionAuth.description: Session-based authentication using a session ID stored in the cookie. The client must send the 'SESSION' cookie (e.g., SESSION=<session-id>) with each request. For state-changing requests (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH), a valid CSRF token must also be included in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header. The CSRF token can be obtained from the XSRF-TOKEN cookie set by the server on GET requests (e.g., by calling GET /issuers or GET /wallets).

bearerAuth.description: JWT-based authentication. Use a valid OAuth2 ID token (e.g., from Google or Microsoft) in the Authorization header as a Bearer token. Example: 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi...'. This token will be used to authenticate the user and establish a session.
